_note: Partner logos. Files in assets/logos/ are WHITE alpha masks (trimmed, transparent background), made from the host's uploads in logos/. Draw them TINTED to a palette color (cream by default; e.g. draw the mask to an offscreen canvas, then globalCompositeOperation='source-in' + fillRect with the color). 'file' null = no logo available: use a clean text wordmark (display) in the condensed font. Keep logos unaltered otherwise (no stretching, no recoloring beyond the single tint, no effects).
